messages:
maria: Starting an emergency patch rollout to production for a session-cache credential leak. Need expedited approvals for changing prod config outside normal change window. @chris @sam please acknowledge.

deploy-bot: /deploy start emergency-patch v2026-03-19-ep1 -> production
Status: canary 1/3 started. UI: https://deploys.redwood/internal/12345

chris: +1 from infra, monitoring hooks are in place. I'll watch the canary group. tagging on-call @oliver.

sam: approve — product ok with a short change window (30m). Release note: "Fix session cache ACL check to prevent credential exposure."

jen: security reviewed and gives thumbs. Add SOC audit note to the release (log ID SOC-2026-042).

deploy-bot: Canary metrics at 5m -> latency: stable, errors: 0.5% (baseline 0.2%). Rolling out to 30% as configured.

oliver: seeing auth error spike on canary host group cg-4 (5xx). Pulling logs now.

maria: Pausing rollout. Can anyone paste quick logs from cg-4? I'm running /logs but want eyes on it.

oliver: log snippet:
```
ERROR 2026-03-19T14:22:11Z token_fetch failed: env var SESSION_SECRET missing
stack: auth_service->session_cache->get_token
```
This looks like a subset of hosts lacked the new env var, causing 500s when token fetch fails.

maria: OK. pausing and holding. Do not continue rollout. Recommend rollback to last stable.

oliver: I agree. Root cause is host config drift. Initiating rollback to v2026-03-18-r7.

deploy-bot: /deploy rollback production --to v2026-03-18-r7
Rollback initiated. Notifying subscribers and updating change log.

chris: Good call. We'll fix the host bootstrap for cg-4 and re-run a dry canary after validation. ETA: 45m for fix + validation.

sam: Noted. I'll update customer comms draft to mention a brief rollback and follow-up patch. Plan: incident post in 30m.

maria: Opening PR for bootstrap fix and adding the verifications to the rollout checklist. PR: https://git.redwood/p/bootstrap-fix (wip). Tagging @infra.

oliver: Monitoring: errors returning to baseline after rollback :white_check_mark:.

maria: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in 40m for the controlled re-deploy. Keeping this thread for approvals and checklist updates.
